entries.46761a63b31b8452: This business operates the beef bowl chain Sukiya directly in Japan, China, Southeast Asia and Central and South America. It serves a wide range of customers, including families and groups, with safe and tasty products at affordable prices, centered on its main beef bowl. It is operated by Sukiya Co., Ltd. and overseas subsidiaries such as Izumisei Catering (Shanghai) Co., Ltd., Taiwan Shanshang Co., Ltd., ZENSHO (THAILAND) CO., LTD. and ZENSHO DO BRASIL COMERCIO DE ALIMENTOS LTDA. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥314,454 million (up 6.3% year on year), and its share of group revenue was 24.9%. Operating profit was ¥9,317 million (down 62.0%). The number of stores at fiscal year-end was 2,650 (2,000 in Japan and 650 overseas), with 112 stores opened and 83 closed during the period. During this period, in addition to implementing beef bowl price cuts, it continued its health and safety measures following a foreign-matter contamination incident at some domestic stores at the end of the prior fiscal year, including strengthened cleaning and planned renovation of aging stores.
